episodes.title: İlişki Durumu Karışık
episodes.summary: Newly single lawyer Leyla starts seeing Feyyaz, a chef she met while on vacation. At work, she takes on the divorce case of entrepreneur Cem Murathan.

episodes.title: Aşşırı Aşk
episodes.summary: Leyla realizes there's more to Cem than his wife would have her believe. Her ex Ömer interrupts a lavish date with Feyyaz.

episodes.title: Behlül Kaçar
episodes.summary: After Feyyaz ghosts her, Leyla takes steps to cut Ömer out of her life, leading him to file for custody of their dog Buddy.

episodes.title: İki İleri Bir Geri
episodes.summary: The divorce case is wrapped up, but Cem keeps his hooks in Leyla. A New Year's Eve party ends with a sudden trip to the hospital.

episodes.title: Yedek Kulübesi
episodes.summary: Cem hires Leyla's firm and asks her to represent him at a winery auction. She keeps her distance but finds herself drawn to him at his hotel's opening.

episodes.title: İç Açılarının Toplamı
episodes.summary: Needing a break from everything, Leyla joins a family gathering where she discovers her parents' marriage isn't as happy as she'd thought.

episodes.title: ya Gel Bana Sahici Sahici ya da Anca Gidersin
episodes.summary: Ömer works his way back into Leyla's life, culminating in a proposal. Leyla envisions a future with him but can't stop thinking about Cem.

episodes.title: Düğün
episodes.summary: Leyla learns the truth about the men in her life — even as she's found her happy ending.

episodes.title: Kırık Kalp Sendromu
episodes.summary: Leyla gets a fresh start when she finally moves into her new home, but Ömer's temper gets the better of him when he lashes out at one of his own friends.

episodes.title: Arkadaşımın Aşkısın
episodes.summary: Defne suffers a devastating loss, but calls on Cem for support, instead of Şeyyaz — who begins to doubt the authenticity of their relationship.

episodes.title: Kaçan Kovalanır
episodes.summary: Nil catches Leyla and Cem in a compromising position, splashing their scandalous relationship all over the news. Beliz decides to file for a divorce.

episodes.title: Kuyruksuz Yalan
episodes.summary: Sarp finds Ömer in a bad condition. Leyla begins to feel the worrying repercussions of being Cem Murathan's object of desire.

episodes.title: Parmağında Yüzükler
episodes.summary: Murat spirals when he finds out about Esra's brief rendezvous with an old flame. Leyla takes an unexpected trip to visit her parents.

episodes.title: Aşşırı Mutlu
episodes.summary: Beliz shows up with an unexpected date at a New Year's Eve party and Cem gifts Leyla with a surprising gesture in hopes of drawing her closer.

episodes.title: Zurnanın Zırt Dediği Yer
episodes.summary: Defne continues to drive Cem and Leyla apart with her mind games. Leyla begins to feel like a stranger in her new home.

episodes.title: Minareden At Beni İn Aşağı Tut Beni
episodes.summary: Cem's true intentions come to light, when jealousy rears its ugly head again. Defne's involvement turns out to be more than it seems.

episodes.title: #COBWEBBING
episodes.summary: With Cem and Defne making public appearances in the lead-up to the court hearing, and her friends on holiday, Leyla has no choice but to make a new friend.

episodes.title: #Mercuryretrograde
episodes.summary: Hoping to cheer up her uncle, Leyla joins her friends at the event — but her positivity dwindles when she finds out whose room is right next door.

episodes.title: #antidepressant
episodes.summary: With Buddy being passed from person to person, he begins to reflect Leyla's turbulent moods as she spirals in the face of the Murathan trial.

episodes.title: #Waltzing
episodes.summary: As Leyla's feelings for Ali deepen, a pair of prying eyes are noting her every move. Is someone really watching her, or is it all inside her head?

episodes.title: #WhereRU
episodes.summary: Leyla is shaken by some security footage, but after she misses an important meeting and Sarp gets home to an empty apartment, her friends begin to worry.

episodes.title: #WhatTheFAQ
episodes.summary: Confused by Leyla's need to reconnect with Cem, Ali chooses to share his deepest desires with her — hoping she will finally admit what truly wants.

episodes.title: #Jamais vu
episodes.summary: When Feyyaz comes to Defne's aid, the lines of loyalty blur — but does she have the strength to speak up against Cem? Sarp reveals his secret to Leyla.

episodes.title: #LEAVING
episodes.summary: An old flame reaches out to Leyla, but she has enough on her plate between secret witnesses, unearthed skeletons and Ali's growing journalism dreams.
